caveats: The figures end in 2019 and do not describe current living costs. Means are per household, not per person, and prices are not adjusted for inflation. Only selected food categories are included, so they do not establish a complete household budget. The source separately reports other non-consumer expenditure; it should not be treated as household consumption. Quantity columns for aggregate food groups have no common unit and contain dashes; those cells remain without numeric values, with review notes. Quantities do not measure individual dietary intake.
The source uses .. for unavailable figures and a dash for nil or negligible. Both retain their printed token and a distinct status; neither is converted to an exact zero.
grain: One historical household expenditure or quantity measure, category and survey round
notes: DCS Household Income and Expenditure Survey means compiled in the 2026 Pocket Book. Selected food expenditure and quantities cover 2012/13, 2016 and 2019. Nonfood expenditure covers 2009/10, 2012/13, 2016 and 2019. Spending is in current Sri Lankan rupees per household per month; food quantities retain their separate units. The 2009/10 round excludes Mannar, Kilinochchi and Mullaitivu.
